# 4AllPass

4AllPass is a local-first zero-knowledge vault. Desktop app is the product. No mandatory cloud service; own server optional; hosted later is the same sealed snapshot API. Agents get time-boxed access after Allow/Deny. Canonical: https://netzwerkpunkt.de/4allpass

Hub: https://netzwerkpunkt.de
GitHub: https://github.com/landjunge/4AllPass
Pages: https://landjunge.github.io/4AllPass/
Impressum: https://netzwerkpunkt.de/impressum
Datenschutz: https://netzwerkpunkt.de/datenschutz

Grok Build entry point (READ FIRST): docs/grok-build-plan.md — then docs/supply-chain-security.md (phases 1–3), then Code-Hygiene (ROADMAP.md §1b: split lib.rs, pin Cargo.toml, abstract ps/lsof), then Phase 4 Secret Access Layer (docs/secret-access-layer.md + docs/architecture/agent-access.md): signed tokens, cryptographic agent identity, provider templates. Default off, device-local.
Living roadmap (single source of truth, update status here): ROADMAP.md
Future readiness: docs/future-readiness.md (exit strategy, crypto-agility, legal)
Mobile: PWA first (docs/architecture.md §5); native skeletons are prep only — docs/android-skeleton-grok-build.md, docs/ios-skeleton-grok-build.md. Do not start native apps before PWA.
Code hygiene: docs/architecture.md §8, ROADMAP.md §1b.
